title: Held-out evaluation + evidence card + demo
acceptance_criterion: A reviewer can reproduce an offline failure and inspect the basis for the shipping decision
verdict: A reviewer genuinely can re-run the experiment and check the frozen-SHA + manifest — the reproducibility half is met. But the 'inspect the basis for the shipping decision' half is thin: the decision rests on secondary metrics because the primary ones are all zero, and two deliverables (freeze tag, demo recording) are missing. Reproduce: yes. Sound basis: no.
evidence: experiments/held-out-v1/{failed_cases.md,uncertainty.md} present; tests/test_held_out.py = 8 tests pass (SpendCeiling, cost fn, manifest round-trip, SHA uncontaminated, ceiling blocks overrun)
held-out SHA in uncertainty.md matches HELD_OUT_SHA256.txt (test-enforced)
gaps: task_success = 0/24 and tool_correctness = 0/24, so the 'basis for the shipping decision' a reviewer inspects is retrieval_recall (1.0 on 5/6 families) + token count — not an end-to-end success signal. EVIDENCE_CARD frames this as a scorer limitation; it is also a direct consequence of tools being stubbed (step 5/6).
The planned freeze tag `experiment-v1-frozen` was never cut, so 'frozen configurations' relies on the manifest code_sha (a5b489b) alone.
docs/demo.md is a 5-minute script, not a recording; the 'demo' deliverable is incomplete.
EVIDENCE_CARD.md claims '5 MVP tools' (2 real) and '144 tests' (tree collects 154) — stale counts.

synthesized.note: The /dev-kit:build runner was never executed in this monorepo. The AgentOps Workbench was built in a standalone repo and imported via PR #8, so no per-step sub-agent subprocess output was ever captured. This file is an audit of the shipped tree under apps/agentops-workbench/ against the step's acceptance criterion, plus a re-run of the deterministic gates on 2026-09-11. status / acceptance_met are judgements against the code as merged, not a recorded process exit.
synthesized.audit: 2026-09-11 (revised — first pass over-reported every step as completed)

gate_rerun.cmd: cd apps/agentops-workbench && uv run pytest -q ; uv run ruff check .
gate_rerun.failing_test_cause: Settings() reads apps/agentops-workbench/.env (strong AGENTOPS_JWT_SECRET) without isolating the pydantic-settings env-file source; the insecure-default assertion is not met. Passes in clean CI. Test-isolation defect, not a production bug.
